newsitem.title: FRANCE: Arthuis postpones hearing on French banking.
newsitem.headline: Arthuis postpones hearing on French banking.

text.p: Finance Minister Jean Arthuis has postponed a speech he was due to make later on Tuesday to a parliamentary group examining France's banking system, National assembly sources said.

The address was postponed due to a hefty agenda on a day when Arthuis was attending a conference on savings and pensions in France and due to address the National Assembly at 1800 GMT on a bill to introduce private pension funds in France.

The pension funds bill, which has been condemned by trade unions as a threat to the traditional pay-as-you-go retirement benefits system, was going through its second reading in the National Assembly on Tuesday.

Arthuis will address the National Assembly on Wednesday on Credit Foncier de France, the lending institution which has been taken over on the government's behalf by the state bank Caisses des Depots et Consignations as the first step in a plan by Arthuis to wind it down.
